label: copy phase: input c when k is output now or next (bigram c-k recall)
explanation: Fires only in the copy phase, almost always (95% of mass) on steps whose fed-back input is c (a little on input k). Strongest when the original contained the bigram c k, so the model is outputting k right after reading back c, and when this happens mid-to-late in recall (recall_idx >= 3; top examples have c at original position 2, e.g. d j c k k). Also fires weakly when k comes one step later. It is silent in the original and delimiter phases, and on c at the first recall positions (recall_idx 1-2) even when k follows. Copy-phase c with no k after it gives only weak, low-quartile activations, which the predicate misses. Dev: precision 0.69, recall 0.54, mass recall 0.75. Requiring out_tok == k alone raises precision to 0.87 but drops mass recall to 0.63.

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues. Raise it: phase=2 & in_tok=c (+8.26), phase=2 & in_tok=k (+5.92), next_out=k (+3.80), phase=2 & out_tok=k (+3.50), in_tok=c (+3.47), out_tok=k (+3.31). Lower it: prev_tok=<DEL> (-2.94), recall_idx=1 (-2.94), prev2_tok=<DEL> (-2.72), out_tok=i (-2.38).
